channel.title: ICHI — Critical vulnerability advisories
channel.description: One advisory per critical active threat ICHI tracks on the Internet Cyber Health Index (ichi.global), then only substantive, evidence-backed developments: exploitation newly established, a CISA KEV listing, a published fix or workaround, additional CVEs, corrections. Each item links to its own page on ichi.global with the supporting sources. A change in ICHI’s own assessment is not news and is not published here. Observation only; no score.

item.title: New advisory: CISA Adds 10 Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
item.description: ICHI assesses Juniper Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router (CVE-2026-103406) as a critical active threat. Exploitation is established by its sources. Listed in the CISA KEV catalog. The vendor states a fix; this does not mean systems are patched. First seen by ICHI 2026-11-25. Patch immediately — CISA remediation due in 2 days Sources: CISA Cybersecurity Advisories https://supportportal.juniper.net/JSA112183 · CISA KEV catalog entry for CVE-2026-103406 https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2026-103406 · CISA Vulnrichment (SSVC) https://github.com/cisagov/vulnrichment/blob/develop/2026/103xxx/CVE-2026-103406.json Details and every source: https://ichi.global/alert?id=ichi-adv-202611-da7198a8aac9177e

item.title: Updated advisory: ARMORY CASTLE Exploits vSphere — Fix published by the vendor
